title: Technical Root Cause Analysis, Forensic Stack Trace & Hotfix Directives
summary: Multi-stage breach simulation (#INC-2026-8891) correlated across 10 modular defense engines over a 120-minute sandbox run on MacBook-Pro-Dev03.lan. Vulnerability chain initiated via typosquatted package @kvch-internal/crypto-utils@1.4.2 merged in PR #4 and wildcard database listener (0.0.0.0:5432). Packed reverse shell (PID 14209, entropy H=7.942) connected to C2 IP 185.220.101.5:443. AegisDB Zero-Trust Proxy halted unpaginated mass table exfiltration at T+111m, and automated SOAR quarantine isolated the host.

edgeguard-sentinel: Origin IPv4 10.0.4.15 leaked via cf-connecting-ip header mismatch.
supply-chain-auditor: Typosquatted package @kvch-internal/crypto-utils@1.4.2 containing curl | sh postinstall hook.
malware-analyzer: Dropped executable /tmp/.system_daemon with Shannon entropy H=7.942 matched YARA MALW_JS_REVERSE_SHELL.
threat-hunter-3000: Outbound reverse shell (PID 14209) to 185.220.101.5:443 & LaunchAgent persistence plist.
cookie-xss-auditor: DOM XSS vulnerability in dashboard-shell.tsx via location.hash leaking session JWTs.
credential-exposure-auditor: Exposed AWS/Stripe keys in .env & clipboard cryptocurrency replacer.
vpn-crypto-analyzer: Split-tunnel DNS leak on tun0 interface bypassing WireGuard tunnel.
aegisdb-zerotrust: Intercepted unpaginated SELECT * FROM users, salaries, private_keys; severed socket FD 42.

activeResponsePayload.command: sudo kill -9 14209 && sudo nft add table inet kvch_quarantine && sudo nft add chain inet kvch_quarantine output { type filter hook output priority 0 \; } && sudo nft add rule inet kvch_quarantine output ip daddr 185.220.101.5 drop && sudo rm -f /tmp/.system_daemon ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.sync.plist && sudo systemctl restart postgresql

finalVerdict: Execute automated SOAR containment immediately: kill PID 14209, drop 185.220.101.5, remove LaunchAgent plist, and restrict PostgreSQL to localhost.
